function.name: OleMetafilePictFromIconAndLabel
function.description: This function creates a metafile picture from an icon and a label, optionally including the source file and icon index.

parameters.name: hIcon
parameters.description: Handle to the icon to be used.

parameters.name: lpszLabel
parameters.description: Pointer to the label to be used.

parameters.name: lpszSourceFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the source file to be used.

parameters.name: iIconIndex
parameters.description: Index of the icon to be used.

function.return_type: HGLOBAL. It represents a handle to a global memory object. This function returns a handle to the metafile picture that it creates.

function.name: IsValidInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface pointer is valid by checking if the pointer itself, its vtable pointer, and the QueryInterface function pointer are readable and executable.

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface to be checked.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the interface is valid, otherwise returns FALSE.
